mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 3% annualized coincides with higher corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of accelerated GDPC1 growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals tight labor markets, which increases wage pressure and cost-push inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of tight labor markets (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 1% annualized indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of INDPRO contraction (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of monetary tightening (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% combined with a 6-month acceleration in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 3% signals a synchronized labor and demand expansion, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% for 3 months AND GDPC1 > 3% annualized for 6 months
regime_hint: synchronized labor and demand expansion regime
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of synchronized labor and demand expansion (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below 1% annualized signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of GDPC1 contraction (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 8% signals a significant labor market weakening, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of labor market shock (t-test p > 0.05).
